<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 74:4">Ib. LXXIV, 4</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 5a:2">B. Bath. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>עיזא בעלמא אַכְלוּיֵי מַכְלִינָן בה</he> v. Ar. s. v. <he>כל</he>; (incorr. in eds. <he>לאו לאכלויי בעיא</he>) as to a goat, we need only shout at her (to drive her off).
Ib. ולאו גברא בעי לאכלויי Rashi (ed. דמיכלי, read דמַכְלֵי) and need you not a man to shout at her?; [oth. opin. we need only keep her off, v. preced.]
